"use client";

import { useState } from 'react';

import { Combobox, Input, InputBase, ScrollArea, useCombobox } from '@mantine/core';

const countries = [
  'Afghanistan',
  'Albania',
  'Algeria',
  'Andorra',
  'Angola',
  'Argentina',
  'Armenia',
  'Australia',
  'Austria',
  'Azerbaijan',
  'Bahamas',

  'Japan',
  'Jordan',
  'Kazakhstan',
  'Kenya',
  'Kiribati',
  'Kuwait',
  'Kyrgyzstan',
  'Laos',
  'Latvia',
  'Lebanon',
  'Lesotho',
  'Liberia',
  'Libya',
  'Liechtenstein',
  'Lithuania',
  'Luxembourg',
  'Madagascar',
  'Malawi',
  'Malaysia',
  'Maldives',
  'Mali',
  'Malta',
  'Mauritania',
  'Mauritius',
  'Mexico',
  'Moldova',
  'Monaco',
  'Mongolia',
];

function Demo() {
  const combobox = useCombobox({
    onDropdownClose: () => combobox.resetSelectedOption(),
  });

  const [value, setValue] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const options = countries.map((item) => (
    <Combobox.Option value={item} key={item}>
      {item}
    </Combobox.Option>
  ));

  return (
    <Combobox
      store={combobox}
      floatingHeight="viewport"
      onOptionSubmit={(val) => {
        setValue(val);
        combobox.closeDropdown();
      }}
    >
      <Combobox.Target>
        <InputBase
          component="button"
          type="button"
          pointer
          rightSection={<Combobox.Chevron />}
          rightSectionPointerEvents="none"
          onClick={() => combobox.toggleDropdown()}
        >
          {value || <Input.Placeholder>Pick a country</Input.Placeholder>}
        </InputBase>
      </Combobox.Target>

      <Combobox.Dropdown>
        <Combobox.Options>
          <ScrollArea.Autosize mah="var(--combobox-floating-options-max-height)" type="scroll">
            {options}
          </ScrollArea.Autosize>
        </Combobox.Options>
      </Combobox.Dropdown>
    </Combobox>
  );
}
const RendynExampleComponent = Demo;
export function RendynExample() { return <RendynExampleComponent  />; }

# Mantine Combobox

Search and choose a value from a list of available options.

## Installation

- Complete MIT usage examples extracted from the upstream demo code template; documentation configurator machinery is excluded.
- Mount MantineProvider once at your client application root and import @mantine/core/styles.css. The returned preview wrapper is a standalone example; reuse an existing provider when integrating.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
